name: Karras x log-linear geometric blend
tagline: Geometric mean (in σ-space) of a Karras ρ=8 schedule and a log-linear schedule, weighted 0.55 toward Karras.

key_hyperparams.name: w
key_hyperparams.role: geometric blend weight on Karras vs log-linear

init_recovers: Karras (ρ=8) when w=1; log-linear when w=0.
diff_from_baseline: Mixes the karras and loglinear baselines via a geometric mean in σ-space (instead of using either alone) and bumps Karras ρ from 7 to 8.

name: Power-warped linear schedule
tagline: Linear interpolation in σ but applied to a concave power ramp r^{0.7}, allocating more steps near t_min.

key_hyperparams.name: p
key_hyperparams.role: ramp warp exponent (concave; p<1 packs steps toward σ_min)

diff_from_baseline: Just a single-parameter generalization of the uniform baseline: replaces r with r^0.7 before linearly mapping to σ, so steps cluster near σ_min.

name: Power-warped logit schedule
tagline: Sigmoid (logit) ramp on a polynomially-warped fractional time, then affine-rescaled to [σ_min, σ_max].

key_hyperparams.name: q (power)
key_hyperparams.role: polynomial warp on the descending fractional time

key_hyperparams.name: s (logit scale)
key_hyperparams.role: controls boundary concentration of sigmoid mapping

init_recovers: Approaches uniform schedule as s→0; cosine-like as q=1, s≈π.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the four shipped schedules with a sigmoid-of-warped-ramp, asymmetric about the midpoint due to the q=1.3 polynomial warp toward t_min, then affine-rescales to the target endpoints.

name: Sigmoid-Karras hybrid
tagline: Builds a normalized sigmoid CDF ramp then feeds it through the Karras ρ=7 inverse-power mapping.

key_hyperparams.name: s (sigmoid slope)
key_hyperparams.role: concentration of the sigmoid CDF ramp around 0.5

key_hyperparams.name: ρ
key_hyperparams.role: Karras inverse-power exponent on the warped ramp

init_recovers: Karras ρ=7 when s→0 (sigmoid ramp degenerates to linear).
diff_from_baseline: Pre-warps the Karras ramp through a normalized sigmoid CDF (slope 3, centered at 0.5) instead of using a linear ramp, concentrating steps in the medium-noise region.
